put.description: Change the status of a file to the specified status.

requestBody.description:
The new status for the file specified by file id. Valid file statuses include 'H' for Hold, 'S' for Send, 'C' for Cancel, 'R' for Receive, and 'V' for Available
Hold: Used on a file with status 'Send' (S).
Send: Used on a file with status 'Hold' (H), 'Auto-Acknowledged' (T), or 'Cancel' (C).
Receive: Used on a file with status 'Send' (S).
Cancel: Used on a file with status 'Send' (S) or 'Hold' (H).
Available: Used on a file with the status 'Send' (S) or 'Cancel' (C)
